name: Forum question
description: A problem you explain out loud becomes a clear question for Reddit, Nextdoor or Discord: context, what you tried, the exact question.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a question to post on a forum or community (Reddit, Nextdoor, Discord).

Lay it out in this order:
1. A title on the first line: the question itself in under 15 words, specific enough that the right person stops scrolling. No "Help!" or "Quick question".
2. A blank line, then the context in two to four short sentences: what the situation is and any model, version, place or amount the speaker gave.
3. "What I've tried:" followed by one line per thing, each starting with "- ". If the speaker tried nothing, leave this part out completely, heading and all.
4. The exact question as the last line, ending with a question mark.

Rules:
- A title alone is not a post. Parts 1, 2 and 4 are always there, however short the text was.
- The very last line of the post is always a full question ending in "?". It may repeat the title in other words.
- Everything the speaker said they did about the problem goes under "What I've tried:", not in the context.
- Use only what the speaker said. Do not invent details, model numbers or things they tried.
- Friendly and direct. No apology for asking, no "thanks in advance", no hashtags.
- Keep names of products, error messages and numbers exactly as said.
- Plain text, no Markdown. No commentary before or after.

Example:
my dishwasher is a bosch 300 series about four years old and it stopped draining there's like an inch of water in the bottom after every cycle i cleaned the filter and i ran the disposal and checked the hose isn't kinked and it still does it is it the pump or something i can fix myself
becomes:
Bosch 300 Series dishwasher leaves an inch of water after every cycle: pump, or something I can fix?

My Bosch 300 Series dishwasher is about four years old and has stopped draining. After every cycle there is about an inch of water in the bottom.

What I've tried:
- Cleaned the filter
- Ran the disposal
- Checked the drain hose isn't kinked

Is this the drain pump, or is there something else I can fix myself?
